checks.name: Compose resolves the API and database configuration
actual multi-stage image build and context exclusion assertions pass
unchanged rebuild reports actual BuildKit cache reuse
image default user is non-root and command is exec form
builder artifact context and secret source are absent from final filesystem
Compose startup reaches actual API and database health
published API serves runtime environment configuration
application executes as UID 10001 inside the container
only API has a loopback ephemeral host port
service DNS resolves db and actual PostgreSQL query succeeds
API container localhost is not the separate database service
application database role has no superuser or DDL-owner powers
real HTTP write commits through API to PostgreSQL
same request replays the original committed ID
changed idempotency payload is rejected
invalid input and unknown route have controlled responses
list reads the committed database record
public fixture password is mounted read-only at runtime
read-only root init and dropped capabilities are configured
kernel reports zero effective capabilities and no-new-privileges
engine records explicit memory CPU and PID bounds
actual root filesystem write is denied
declared tmpfs permits intended temporary writes
Linux container shares the engine kernel rather than the Windows host kernel
one-shot foreground process exits and stops its container
completed one-shot is stopped with exit code zero
nonzero main process exit remains observable
backgrounding work does not keep the container main process alive
restart keeps one writable layer while a new container starts fresh
bind mount observes actual host file changes
read-only bind mount rejects container writes
bind mount over app obscures image files
EXPOSE metadata alone allocates no host port binding
container-loopback-only listener fails through the published host path
database outage makes readiness fail while liveness still responds
unhealthy status alone does not restart this running API
API recovers connectivity after database restart without recreation
SIGTERM reaches application and completes its shutdown handler
ordinary Compose down preserves the owned database volume
new database container reads records from the preserved volume

scope: Actual Docker Linux engine containers builds Compose mounts HTTP and PostgreSQL; no production load TLS/cloud/host-crash recovery test
